## Motivation
Protect the no-index fallback for Mistral checkpoints that contain both a consolidated safetensors file and the standard model safetensors file. Selecting the model file must not depend on the input file order.

Closes #47602

## Modifications
- Add a CPU unit test for both input orders of the Mistral file pair.
- Verify unrelated two-file checkpoints retain both files.

Validation: `python -m py_compile test/registered/unit/model_loader/test_weight_utils.py` passed; `git diff --check` passed. The focused pytest could not collect because `torch` is not installed in this environment.

## Accuracy Tests
Not applicable; this test-only change does not affect model outputs.

## Speed Tests and Profiling
Not applicable; this test-only change does not affect inference speed.

## Checklist

- [ ] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process
1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

+    def test_unindexed_mistral_pair_filters_only_the_consolidated_file(self):
+        model = os.path.join(self.folder, "model.safetensors")
+        consolidated = os.path.join(self.folder, "consolidated.safetensors")
+        cases = (
+            ([consolidated, model], [model]),
+            ([model, consolidated], [model]),
+            (
+                [
+                    os.path.join(self.folder, "first.safetensors"),
+                    os.path.join(self.folder, "second.safetensors"),
+                ],
+                [
+                    os.path.join(self.folder, "first.safetensors"),
+                    os.path.join(self.folder, "second.safetensors"),
+                ],
+            ),
+        )
+
+        for weight_files, expected in cases:
+            with self.subTest(weight_files=weight_files):
+                result = filter_duplicate_safetensors_files(
+                    hf_weights_files=weight_files,
+                    hf_folder=self.folder,
+                    index_file=INDEX_NAME,
+                )
+                self.assertCountEqual(result, expected)
+
